incident.symptom: The low-level scalachess FullFen path normalized malformed en-passant token z9 to no square while the pinned chessops parser rejected it.
incident.false_inference: Acceptance by Fen.read proves that an input string is valid FEN and belongs to the public dialect contract.
incident.cause: FullFen is an opaque string wrapper and the reader assumes validation has already occurred; invalid square text becomes None.
incident.prevention: Project-owned engine, referee, dataset, and model-tool boundaries reject malformed FEN syntax before rules execution while retaining Lichess semantics for valid FEN.
incident.gate_effect: P2 FEN policy is closed; P3 and P4 require the negative parser fixture to pass in candidate and referee.

authority_conflict_resolution.valid_castling_text: accepted and canonicalized to no rights
authority_conflict_resolution.valid_ineffective_en_passant: accepted and canonicalized to no square
authority_conflict_resolution.malformed_en_passant: rejected fail-closed by every project-owned public boundary

pinned_evidence.observation: z9 was accepted by the low-level probe and canonicalized to '-'.
Public service paths clean and parse FullFen text but do not supply a strict EP token validator before the low-level reader.
The same z9 input was rejected with ERR_EP_SQUARE.
